    The dimension of a positive filtered deformation #

    A positive filtered deformation B of Λ (Definition 6.2) has dim B = dim Λ: each layer F^d/F^{d+1} is identified with Λ_d by the leading-term map.

    theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.LenGrading.finrank_eq_sum {k : Type u} [Field k] {Λ : Type v} [Ring Λ] [Algebra k Λ] [FiniteDimensional k Λ] (G : LenGrading k Λ) :
    Module.finrank k Λ = ∑ d : Fin G.N, Module.finrank k ↥(G.proj ↑d).range

    A graded algebra is the sum of its components.

    theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.PosFiltration.finrank_step {k : Type u} [Field k] {Λ : Type v} [Ring Λ] [Algebra k Λ] {G : LenGrading k Λ} {B : Type w} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] (P : PosFiltration G B) [FiniteDimensional k B] (d : ℕ) :
    Module.finrank k ↥(P.F d) = Module.finrank k ↥(P.F (d + 1)) + Module.finrank k ↥(G.proj d).range
    source
    theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.PosFiltration.finrank_F_zero {k : Type u} [Field k] {Λ : Type v} [Ring Λ] [Algebra k Λ] {G : LenGrading k Λ} {B : Type w} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] (P : PosFiltration G B) [FiniteDimensional k B] (n : ℕ) :
    Module.finrank k ↥(P.F 0) = Module.finrank k ↥(P.F n) + ∑ d ∈ Finset.range n, Module.finrank k ↥(G.proj d).range

    theorem MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.PosFiltration.finrank_eq {k : Type u} [Field k] {Λ : Type v} [Ring Λ] [Algebra k Λ] {G : LenGrading k Λ} {B : Type w} [Ring B] [Algebra k B] (P : PosFiltration G B) [FiniteDimensional k B] [FiniteDimensional k Λ] :
